fields.title: Orbit of the Void
fields.description: Genre: Dark Psytrance / Dark Goa; Tempo: 145; Motor: dry relentless straight 16th mono psybass and precise kick; Energy: progressive escalating pressure with intentional releases; Mid: acid dialogue and evolving percussive patterns; High: spectral orbital motion and controlled psychedelic disorientation; Psychoacoustics: rotating spectral proximity reflections; Atmosphere: cold cyber-forest
fields.negative: pop chorus, bouncy bass, happy EDM drop
